title: Grade from a mark
description:
Turn a mark into a letter with signed comparisons.

```
Mark: 83
B
Mark: -4
out of range
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Mark: ", 0
bad:    db      "out of range", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `cmp rax, 0` / `jl .bad` and `cmp rax, 100` / `jg .bad` first; then test from 90 down (lesson 3.03).
`ja` and `jb` are unsigned: with them, -4 looks like a huge number and lands in the wrong branch.
requirements: 90 to 100 A, 80 B, 70 C, 60 D, 0 to 59 F; anything else `out of range`.
Use signed jumps (`jl`, `jge`), so negative marks are caught.
stretch: Add + and - grades (87 to 89 is B+).
